CFML Language Reference: Functions

StructUpdate

Replaces the value stored under a key that already exists in the structure.

Category

Structure functions

Syntax

StructUpdate(structure, key, value)

Parameters

structure
The structure to change.
key
An existing key.
value
The new value.

Returns

TRUE (prints as YES).

Usage

If the key does not exist, an Expression exception is thrown; use StructInsert to add new keys. This makes StructUpdate a cheap way to catch misspelled key names.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Stock = StructNew()>
<CFSET Stock.Modems = 12>
<CFSET Temp = StructUpdate(Stock, "Modems", Stock.Modems - 1)>
<CFOUTPUT><P>Sold a modem. Modems left: <B>#Stock.Modems#</B></P></CFOUTPUT>
<CFTRY>
  <CFSET Temp = StructUpdate(Stock, "Modemz", 0)>
<CFCATCH TYPE="Expression">
  <CFOUTPUT><P>Typo caught: <I>#CFCATCH.Message#</I></P></CFOUTPUT>
</CFCATCH>
</CFTRY>

See also

StructInsert, StructFind, StructKeyExists
